task_specification.objective: Repair authored-world spatial integrity and complete-run lifecycle, implement the required accessible choice hierarchy, and harden dense-wave runtime behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: Mausoleum geometry and camera sight lanes still permit partial Warden/threat occlusion during traversal.

stop_conditions: Preserve AuthoredCemeteryPackage and retained weapon identities.
Do not implement deferred backlog gaps.
Stop after candidate implementation and focused self-validation; Tester owns closure.

strategy.rationale: Use integrated collision/camera/navigation/outer-datum repair instead of repeating isolated transform tuning, while keeping shell presentation and dense lifecycle work bounded.

code: Run Godot parse/import and targeted static checks for camera bounds, collision/navigation ownership, HUD predicates, focus wiring, run reset, and pool cleanup.
Verify preserved authored assets, weapon identities, and source audio remain unmodified.
runtime: Host recaptures validate:release_convergence_camera_movement_dash_contract and validate:release_convergence_complete_run_release_contract through spawn, ordinary movement/dash, mausoleum approach/contact/departure, perimeter replay, failure/victory, three successful build shapes, Result, and Retry.

Host recaptures the adjacent choice hierarchy and shell capability across title, gameplay HUD, upgrade, pause, death, victory, Result, and Retry at supported resolutions/scales with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus.

Host recaptures validate:release_convergence_dense_run_performance_contract at baseline, 25-40-enemy swarm, Bellkeeper boss, and three retries with frame-time, actor-count, allocation, and cleanup evidence; Tester owns interpretation and closure.
visual: Capture sparse shipped-camera views for spawn, critical route, central building/landmark, perimeter, near contact, departure, and ordinary movement replay; verify external world/external depth, collision, escape lanes, and no disappearance/occlusion.
Capture HUD and shell pages with focused upgrade cards, truthful deltas, pause/result/retry states, and title presentation.
Capture distinct dense-wave and boss frames paired with runtime states; screenshots and telemetry are Tester evidence, not automatic verdicts.

done_when: Use a larger traversable scale or demonstrably expand the route.
Provide a coherent external world/external depth beyond the playable perimeter.
Keep the central building/landmark visible before approach, near contact, and departure with no disappearance or occlusion during ordinary movement/movement replay.
Align collision/navigation to the landmark and every boundary/perimeter; prevent pass-through and escape.
Keep camera follow and dash readable around the mausoleum.
Support failure, victory, Result, Retry, and three distinct viable successful build shapes with truthful statistics, provenance, and replay reset.
Provide direct black-box and white-box retests for finding.camera_occlusion.
tasks.instructions: Repair camera, player collision, navigation, spawn/objective anchors, and outer datum around the intact AuthoredCemeteryPackage. Ensure ordinary movement and dash replay cannot cause mausoleum occlusion, landmark disappearance, or pass-through. Make authoritative title-to-result play, failure/victory branches, three viable build shapes, statistics, provenance, and retry reset work.
tasks.title: Repair spatial binding and complete run

done_when: Gameplay HUD exposes authoritative health, XP/level, wave/run progress, weapon ranks, dash readiness, and boss health without covering the arena.
Upgrade choices lead with authored silhouettes/icons, compact stat icons, and truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas.
CURRENT never contains NEW or LOCKED; unchanged, zero, unrelated, and exhaustive rows are omitted.
Title, settings, upgrade, pause, death, victory, Result, and Retry compose the full viewport at supported resolutions and UI scales.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, confirm, cancel, and return-to-gameplay states are complete and debounced; settings persist.
Stable page predicates support Tester probes for every shell state.
tasks.instructions: Implement the required choice visual hierarchy and accessible Mournlight shell in existing HUD, shell, pause, and upgrade scenes. Preserve weapon identities and result presentation. Use authored silhouettes, compact icons, truthful deltas, complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states, safe-lane layout, persisted settings, and authoritative transitions. Expose stable predicates without release-only tester actions.
tasks.title: Implement authored choices and accessible shell

done_when: At 1920x1080 with 25-40 ordinary enemies plus all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI, and audio, frame-time remains stable.
Spawn, steering, attack, projectile, pickup, and effect work is bounded without runaway allocations, orphaned timers, unbounded searches, or stale references.
Pooling/reset clears enemy health, targets, velocity, timers, status, animation, collision, signals, visibility, and deferred work across three complete retries.
Wave escalation, Bellkeeper phases, automatic attacks, XP/upgrade transactions, pause, death, victory, Result, and Retry remain functional under dense load.
Tester can compare baseline, dense swarm, boss, and three retry checkpoints using runtime metrics and gameplay frames.
tasks.instructions: Harden wave director, encounter spawner, enemy actor/registry, attack runtime, and reward/projectile lifecycle with bounded registries, staggered updates, or reuse. Preserve deterministic spawn safety, readable motion, combat causality, and Bellkeeper pacing. Tear down transient actors, timers, signals, pools, audio, and VFX on pause, death, reset, and retry.
tasks.title: Harden dense-wave performance and lifecycle
